## Schema extraction for Team 5 {#app-team5 .unnumbered}

For the many-analysts football study of @silberzahn2018, the workflow takes
as input a pre-extracted methodology text for each team rather than the
original report. The text used for Team 5 is quoted below, and
@lst-team5-schema gives the schema extracted from it, illustrating both the
input and the output of the extraction stage.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
txt <- readLines(here::here("schemas/team5.txt"))
txt <- txt[!(seq_along(txt) > length(txt) - 3 & !nzchar(trimws(txt)))]
cat(ifelse(nzchar(trimws(txt)), paste0("> ", txt), ">"), sep = "\n")
cat("\n")
```

:::{#lst-team5-schema lst-cap="The schema extracted from the Team 5 methodology text quoted above. Two steps are returned with medium confidence, each carrying the clarification question the model would put to the analyst."}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat("````yaml\n")
cat(readLines(here::here("schemas/schema-team5.yaml")), sep = "\n")
cat("````\n")
```
:::

@lst-team5-code gives the script generated and validated from that schema,
completing the pipeline from methodology text to executable code for this
team. As in the main paper, the script is annotated with the schema step each
block implements. Although the schema specifies `glmer()` from `lme4`, the
script fits the model with `glmmTMB()`, reflecting the substitution of faster
model-fitting functions described in the main paper.

:::{#lst-team5-code lst-cap="The R script generated and validated from the schema in @lst-team5-schema."}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat("````r\n")
cat(readLines(here::here("schemas/script-team5.R")), sep = "\n")
cat("````\n")
```
:::

## Built-in prompts {#app-prompt .unnumbered}

The prompts that `tines` uses at each stage of the workflow are reproduced
below, with placeholders in square brackets.

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: extracting the schema from the text

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_extract_schema(text = "[insert text here]", data_dict = NA)
```

:::

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: generating code from the schema

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_gen_code()
```
:::


:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: validating the generated code

```{r echo = FALSE}
cat(strwrap(tines:::build_sys_prompt(data = "[insert the path to the data]"), width = 70), sep = "\n")
```
:::

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: generating alternatives for a specific step

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_alternatives(step = "[insert step number here]")
```

:::
